prompts.prompt:
[FORMAT]
Vertical 2:3 Pinterest pin composition. Long-form story pin ratio 1:2.1 with generous upper-third breathing room for post-production text overlay — rendered as a naturally dim atmospheric gradient of pre-dawn ambient shadow, not a flat band or empty rectangle, but a seamless continuation of the scene's deep morning darkness fading into soft lamplight below.

[SUBJECT]
A worn wooden desk at 5 AM, pre-dawn hour. A leather-bound diary lies open at a slight angle, a fine-tipped brass fountain pen and a slim mechanical pencil resting diagonally across the pages. A single small terracotta pot holds a delicate four-leaf clover plant with two tiny leaves catching the warm lamp glow. A ceramic mug of tea sits slightly out of focus in the background, steam barely visible. No text, no lettering, no words visible anywhere — pages of diary are blank cream paper with faint ruled lines only.

[COMPOSITION]
Vertical framing, 35mm natural lens perspective, f/2.8 aperture. Diary and pen anchor the lower two-thirds using rule of thirds — clover pot placed at right-third vertical axis as a warm accent point. Upper third dissolves naturally into the pre-dawn atmospheric darkness of the room, window barely suggesting night sky beyond. Strong top-to-bottom hierarchy: deep quiet dark at top → warm pool of lamplight at center → tactile paper and wood grain at base. Hand-crafted, unhurried, not stock.

[AESTHETIC]
Pinterest-native: warm, lived-in, deeply quiet. Dark academia meets quiet luxury — pre-dawn solitude aesthetic. Cottagecore paper warmth. The feeling of 5 AM when the world is still asleep and a single lamp is the only companion. Unhurried, intentional, deeply personal.

[LIGHTING]
Single motivated practical light source — a small warm desk lamp positioned 45° camera-right, casting a gentle pool of 2800K tungsten candlelight warmth across the diary pages and clover pot. Soft falloff with gradient transition into deep pre-dawn shadow on the left side. Deep shadow side with selective fill — left edge of frame holds near-darkness. No fill light. No window light — pure pre-dawn 5 AM, exterior completely dark. Gentle highlight rolloff on paper texture and ceramic pot rim. Dappled broken shadow from clover leaves falling softly across diary pages.

[SURFACE & TEXTURE]
Raw oak wood grain desk surface, worn and slightly marked with use. Aged paper diary pages — cream, slightly yellowed at edges, tactile tooth visible. Worn leather diary cover, dark cognac. Woven jute texture in soft background. Terracotta ceramic pot, unglazed matte finish. Every surface reads as touched, used, loved — never sterile.

[COLOR PALETTE]
Muted pre-dawn palette: deep warm shadow brown, cognac leather, cream parchment, soft sage green of clover leaves, terracotta pot orange-earth, amber lamplight gold. Two dominant tones: deep warm shadow and parchment cream. Accent: soft sage. No neon, no oversaturation. Film-like tonal compression in shadows.

[STYLE REFERENCE]
In the style of Beth Kirby, Brittany Ambridge, and Jamie Hawkesworth. Editorial Pinterest aesthetic — intimate, atmospheric, save-worthy.

[QUALITY MARKERS]
Save-worthy, scroll-stopping, magazine-quality. Hyper-detailed paper texture, visible wood grain micro-detail, photorealistic clover leaf translucency against lamplight. Film grain in shadow regions. Emotionally resonant pre-dawn quiet. No words, no text, no lettering, no typography anywhere in the image.

[AVOID]
no AI artifacts, no warped or smeared text, no fake words baked into the image,
no plastic look, no waxy surface, no cartoonish rendering,
no extra fingers, no extra limbs, no melted geometry, no doubled subjects,
no oversaturated HDR, no HDR halos, no oversharpened look,
no flat fluorescent lighting, no harsh on-camera flash,
no generic stock photography poses, no cliché compositions,
no random unrelated brand logos, no watermarks, no signatures,
no AI sheen, no doll-like rendering, no airbrush look,
no flat solid color bands, no empty rectangular areas, no dull gradient zones,
no stale stock photography aesthetic, no synthetic stock-photo look,
no over-staged feeling, no unrealistically clean environments,
no oversaturated colors, no neon, no Instagram-grid square framing,
no horizontal-leaning compositions, no sterile feel,
no visible text, no diary writing, no handwriting, no printed words, no letters, no numbers anywhere in the frame.
